text:
sophia_ops: @here heads-up: rolling out a small dedicated A800x-mini pool in Johannesburg (jnb1) for preview customers today. Pool: `dedicated-A800xmini-jnb1-preview`. Initial capacity: 8 cards. Goal is lower p95 for AFR/SAN traffic. :south_africa:

mateo_pm: Nice. Any special billing or reservation caveats?

sophia_ops: Preview pricing applies; reservations supported via CLI and Console. Fallback policy: jnb1 -> lon1 -> global-hosted. We'll surface fallbacks in the Console and in logs.

darya_sre: Rollout schedule and stop criteria? Need to hook dashboards and set alerts.

sophia_ops: Canary starts 2026-05-10T09:00Z for 45m, then scale to preview. Probes: `jnb1-a800x-p95`, `jnb1-a800x-health`. Pause if fallback > 6% in 15m or error-rate > 0.3%. Runbook: internal link (ops).

kevin_sales: I'll notify pilot accounts in EMEA+AFR. Any migration CLI snippet to share?

sophia_ops: Yep: `rb-reserve --pool dedicated-A800xmini-jnb1-preview --size 2 --duration 14d`. We'll include the CLI example and a short FAQ in the customer email.

olivia_ce: Are quant/compile artifacts pre-baked on images or do customers recompile?

darya_sre: Two pre-baked quant profiles (fp8-std, int8-lite). Custom or unusual topologies will need a one-time compile; reservation UI shows a warning.

mateo_pm: Can we add a Console banner: "jnb1 A800x-mini preview may fallback to LON1 during canary" and link to docs?

sophia_ops: Will add banner and enable detailed fallback logging for 72h. Also enabling low-level tracing for the canary window.

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered for `dedicated-A800xmini-jnb1-preview` at 2026-05-10T09:00:12Z (canary).

sophia_ops: Monitoring anchors for CE/SRE: token p95 latency, KV cache hit-rate, fallback %, and error-rate. If fallback spike > 6% OR error-rate > 0.3% we stop scale and roll back.

kevin_sales: Thanks — I'll send the pilot announcement and attach migration steps and billing caveat.

olivia_ce: Can we schedule a 30m walkthrough for CE+Sales tomorrow 08:00 PT to go over demo scripts and expected latencies?

sophia_ops: Scheduled. Calendar invite sent. :white_check_mark:
